messages.subject: problem with FragmentLengthNormalization

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: problem with FragmentLengthNormalization
parts:
Hi,

I don't understand where the expression

matrix(data=0, ncol=length(snp.per.gene), nrow=length(snp.per.gene))

It is not in aroma.affymetrix. When you say you start a new R
session, are you sure you also start without loading a saved image?
Basically, when you start R, make sure you that 'objs' is empty when
you do:

> objs <- ls(all.names=FALSE);
> print(objs);
> str(objs);

Then load aroma.affymetrix and run your script. Also, what does

> print(summary)

> print(summary.matrix)

give after you get the error message?

/Henrik
